name: Data Center de l'Administration Publique (national public-administration data centre)
developer: Government of the Union of the Comoros - ANADEN (Agence Nationale de Developpement du Numerique) and Comores Cables S.A. (co-managed); AfDB PADEC financing (P-KM-G00-001)
notes: Confirmed national/public facility (Grande Comore, Moroni area; exact commune/address not public). ANADEN official Realisations page (A-grade) states ANADEN and Comores Cables announced inauguration of the Data Center de l'Administration Publique on 19 May 2025, under President Azali Assoumani and the Minister of Posts/Telecom/Digital Economy; purpose: secure hosting, centralisation and backup of public data, IT-resource mutualisation, service resilience; supports national DNS, digital identity and e-service portals (Comores Numerique 2028 / Plan Comores Emergent). Comores Cables now markets advanced data-management and hosting solutions from its datacenter (comorescables.km, A-grade company statement). Press reports (Agence Ecofin 2025-05-14; Dig Watch) add claimed Tier 3 and '44.4 Tb' hosting capacity - unit ambiguous as published; Tier-3 is self-declared, NO TIA-942/EPI/Uptime certification entry found for Comoros. No MW capacity disclosed (capacity_mw null).

name: PADEC secondary data centre upgrade ('mise a niveau du secondaire')
developer: Government of the Union of the Comoros via ANADEN; African Development Bank (AfDB) PADEC - P-KM-G00-001
notes: Lead (facility identity unverified). AfDB PADEC (Projet d'Appui a la Digitalisation de l'Economie Comorienne, approved 2024) procurement plan (PPM 2025-07-02) includes supply/install of equipment for a primary datacentre + digital incubator and 'mise a niveau du secondaire' (upgrade of a secondary datacentre). Candidate secondary facility unconfirmed: Comores Telecom server facility (HQ Place Volo-volo, Moroni) and/or a government IT facility. PADEC officially launched 27-28 Mar 2025 (ANADEN, A-grade). A-grade for AfDB financing scope; facility identity B/C until a primary source names it. No capacity data (null).

name: Comores Telecom HQ server rooms / NOC (Place Volo-volo, BP 7000, Moroni)
developer: Comores Telecom (Societe Nationale des Telecommunications; Huri brand)
notes: Lead only - no public datacenter/colo offer verified. Historic state operator (created by ordonnance 04-002/PR of 23 Feb 2004; operations from 1 Apr 2005); HQ address Place Volo-volo, BP 7000, Moroni (A-grade address fact). 5G frequency attributed by ANRTIC 2025-05-27. HQ/NOC/server-room facility details not published (C); frequent SONELEC grid outages mean generator/UPS presence is not datacenter evidence.

name: Yas Comores (ex-Telma Comores) core/network sites
notes: Lead only - no public datacenter/colo offer verified. Second licensee since 2016 (ex-Telma Comores, AXIAN Telecom group); first 5G launch reported May 2025; ~EUR 25M (US$28.8M) IFC loan announced 2025-06-20 for 5G/FTTH/FTTO and network expansion (A-grade operator/group financing facts). HQ/core in Moroni (Grande Comore) with network sites across the three islands; facility details not published (C).

name: Itsandra landing station (FLY-LION3 + 2Africa Comoros branch)
developer: Comores Cables S.A. (FLY-LION3 consortium with Orange/SRR; 2Africa Comoros branch)
notes: Connectivity site (asset class: cable landing / interconnection anchor, NOT a datacenter). FLY-LION3 (Moroni-Kaweni 400 km) connects at Itsandra station (~2021); 2Africa Comoros branch landed at Itsandra beach 2023-01-12 (Al-Watwan, B). Moroni area hosts 4 cable systems (EASSy ~2012, Avassa 2016, FLY-LION3, 2Africa); Chindini hosts 2. Landing stations only become facility records with server/hosting/colo evidence; none verified beyond the national DC. Mayotte facilities (Kaweni/Mamoudzou) out of scope.
